title: 夜港无声
subtitle: NIGHT HARBOR
brief: 暴雨中的货运港，先关闭堆场警报 A，再下载仓库资料 B，最后开启码头通道 C。蹲伏与掩体降低警戒；开枪会暴露位置。绿色 S 柜补给，蓝色 EMP 争取脱身时间。

en.title: Silent Harbor
en.brief: Infiltrate the rain-soaked cargo port. Disable yard alarm A, download the warehouse data at B, then open exit C. Crouch and use cover to lower alert; firing reveals your position. Green S cabinets replenish supplies. Blue EMP devices buy you time to escape.
